data.name: Castiel
data.gender_notes: Castiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Castiel is an angelic name derived from Hebrew, meaning 'God's treasure'. In Christian and Jewish traditions, Castiel is often depicted as a powerful and compassionate angel, serving as a messenger between God and humanity. Castiel's name embodies the spiritual qualities of protection, faith, and wisdom. The name Castiel carries the meaning “God's Treasure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Castiel usually hope their child will grow to embody god's treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Castiel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Castiel total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: קסטיאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קסטיאל מורכב משתי מילים עבריות: 'קסט' שפירושו עוזר או תומך, ו'אל' שפירושו אלוהים. לפיכך, קסטיאל פירושו 'אלוהים הוא עוזרי' או 'אלוהים עוזר'. השם קסטיאל מופיע בתפילות ופיוטים יהודיים ככינוי לאחד המלאכים המשרתים את האל.

in_greek.name: Καστιήλ
in_greek.meaning: Θεός βοηθός - Θεός είναι ο βοηθός
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καστιήλ προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές λέξεις 'קסט' (βοηθός) και 'אל' (Θεός). Στη Καινή Διαθήκη δεν εμφανίζεται, αλλά στη παράδοση της Ανατολικής Ορθόδοξης Εκκλησίας, ο Καστιήλ αναφέρεται ως ένας από τους αρχαγγέλους.

in_latin.name: Castiel
in_latin.meaning: Deus adiutor - Deus est adiutor meus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Castiel derivatur ex vocibus hebraicis 'קסט' (adiutor) et 'אל' (Deus). In traditione christiana, Castiel consideratur unus ex angelis qui assistunt Deo. Nomen hoc saeculo XXI divulgatum est per seriem televisivam 'Supernatural'.

in_english.name: Castiel
in_english.meaning: God is my helper or God helps
in_english.long_meaning: The name Castiel originates from Hebrew roots 'קסט' (qast) meaning 'helper' and 'אל' (El) meaning 'God'. Hence, Castiel translates to 'God is my helper' or 'God helps'. Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, Castiel has been adopted in Christian tradition as one of the angels serving God. The name gained popularity through the TV series 'Supernatural'.

biblical_reference.note: Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name follows biblical structure and is used in Jewish and Christian traditions.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
